events.start: div onMouseDown sets isDragging=true and immediately calls setter. Setter calls preventDefault; no stopPropagation in extracted setter.
events.move: window mousemove handler calls setter only while isDragging. Off-pad coordinates remain clamped to bounds.
events.end: window mouseup sets isDragging=false. No color commit/Apply on mouseup in these components.
events.cleanup: React effects add window mousemove/mouseup and remove same callbacks on effect cleanup; handlers depend on isDragging.
events.map_sync: PaletteMap skips props.color-driven grip synchronization while colorChangedBySetHelper flag true; local setter sets flag; isDragging=false effect clears flag. This preserves direct cursor-derived grip during local change instead of always recomputing from quantizedHEX.

events.keyboard_touch: No onKeyDown/onKeyUp, slider aria/tabIndex, touch or pointer-event handler in these captured PaletteMap/Hue components. Browser/base-layer/global keyboard behavior is not thereby proved absent. Own arrow-key/touch/pointer support would be independent policy.
